title: Bipol: Multi-axes Evaluation of Bias with Explainability in Benchmark Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the bipol metric, which employs a two-stage process combining a trained classification model to flag biased samples and a lexicon-based frequency analysis of gender-specific terms (e.g., male, female) to quantify and explain the bias.
Measured using the bipol metric's multi-axes lexica by calculating the frequency difference of race-associated terms (e.g., black, white) within the text data classified as biased.
Detected and explained using the bipol metric's multi-axes lexica to identify the frequency of religion-associated terms within datasets like Boolq.
